item.title: 二维 Hubbard 模型中 Transformer 反流神经量子态的优化动力学
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Zong-Yu Liao, Jia-Qi Wang, Rong-Qiang He, Zhong-Yi Lu
本文研究多行列式 Transformer 反流神经量子态在掺杂二维 Hubbard 模型中的优化动力学如何依赖关键优化与结构超参数。训练流程包括神经网络反流初始化、监督式 Transformer 预训练，以及基于变分蒙特卡罗和 MARCH 方法的主能量优化。以 U=8 的 4×4 周期 Hubbard 模型为基准，作者分析了更新范数阈值、Transformer 宽度、行列式通道数和蒙特卡罗批量大小对收敛的影响，并进一步在半填充、弱相互作用、开边界和更大晶格上测试了该流程。

item.title: AB-PINNs：用于残差驱动区域分解的自适应基物理信息神经网络
item.description:
📚 Machine Learning: Science and Technology
👤 Jonah Botvinick-Greenhouse, Wael H Ali, Mouhacine Benosman and Saviz Mowlavi
本文提出自适应基物理信息神经网络 AB-PINNs，用于在训练过程中动态调整 PINNs 的区域分解，使可学习子区域与未知解的内在特征相匹配。局部网络刻画各子区域内的细尺度结构，全局网络学习大尺度解结构，并在高残差区域按需引入新子区域。数值结果表明，与标准 PINNs 及静态区域分解方法相比，该框架在多尺度问题中具有更快收敛和更少超参数调节需求的潜力。

item.title: Quantum machine learning for predicting properties of van der Waals bilayers
item.description:
📚 The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue

item.title: Machine learning of electronic structure and atomistic properties from the external potential
item.description:
📚 The Journal of Chemical Physics Current Issue
Electronic structure calculations remain a major bottleneck in atomistic simulations and, not surprisingly, have attracted significant attention in machine learning (ML). Most existing approaches learn a direct map from molecular geometries, typically represented as graphs or encoded local environments, to molecular properties or use ML as a surrogate for electronic structure theory by targeting quantities, such as Fock or density matrices expressed in an atomic orbital (AO) basis. Inspired by the Hohenberg–Kohn theorem, in this work, we propose an operator-centric framework in which the external (nuclear) potential, expressed in an AO basis, serves as the model input. From this operator, we construct hierarchical, body-ordered representations of atomic configurations that closely mirror…

item.title: Physics-Informed Federated Learning for Decentralized Pharmaceutical Crystallization: Achieving Personalized Predictive Accuracy with Minimal Data
item.description:
📚 Preprints
👤 Sai Vinay Thattukolla
In decentralized pharmaceutical manufacturing, developing robust predictive models for crystallization is often hindered by proprietary data silos and the inherent heterogeneity of site-specific process dynamics. Standard machine learning approaches struggle with data scarcity and frequently fail to respect the underlying physical laws, leading to catastrophic divergence in outlier scenarios. This study introduces a novel Physics-Informed Federated Learning (F-PINN) framework designed to enable collaborative model training across multiple manufacturing sites while strictly preserving data privacy. By embedding the Population Balance Equation (PBE) directly into the federated global loss function, the F-PINN framework acts as a "Physical Foundation Model" that remains robust against sensor…

item.title: 撒哈拉以南非洲通胀预测中机器学习与计量模型的比较评估
item.description:
📚 Preprints
👤 Baffour Osei, Abigail Boatemaa, Isaac Nyame, Gabriel Osei Forkuo
本文基于八个撒哈拉以南非洲经济体的可复现年度宏观面板数据，比较了随机游走、线性计量模型、机器学习模型和LSTM网络在通胀预测中的表现。研究采用时间顺序划分样本并结合Diebold-Mariano检验评估样本外预测精度。结果显示，没有任何估计模型能够显著优于简单的持续性基准；部分机器学习模型仅能与其持平，而传统线性模型和未作早停处理的LSTM则明显更差。

item.title: Probabilistic Physics-Informed Neural Networks for Estimating Heterogeneous Elastic Properties from Low-Resolution and Noisy Displacement Data
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Tatthapong Srikitrungruang, Jaesung Lee
arXiv:2607.14563v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Estimating spatially heterogeneous elastic properties from low-resolution displacement measurements is a severely ill-posed inverse elasticity problem because low resolution obscures spatial details needed to distinguish heterogeneous property variations, and small measurement perturbations or fitting errors are amplified through inverse estimation. Existing inverse methods often rely on high-fidelity observations and manually prespecified loss weights, limiting their adaptability and making them sensitive to noise and resolution degradation. We propose a Probabilistic Inverse Elasticity Physics-Informed Neural Network (PIE-PINN) framework for robust estimation of Young's modulus and Poisson's ratio from noisy, low-resolution displacement da…

item.description:

arXiv:2607.15087v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) have emerged as a powerful framework for solving forward and inverse partial differential equations (PDEs), but conventional real-valued PINNs (RV-PINNs) often suffer from spectral bias, limited expressivity, and reduced accuracy for high-frequency, oscillatory, and phase-dependent dynamics. item.title: 与超导体耦合的交替磁自旋织构：畴壁自旋三重态超导与超电流诱导力矩
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Yasir Dar, Mathias S. Scheurer, Constantin Schrade
该研究考察空间变化的交替磁体与常规s波超导体耦合时库珀对的形式，强调交替磁序纹理对超导近邻效应的重要影响。由于交替磁性不利于自旋单态配对且磁序纹理降低局域对称性，超导主要影响交替磁畴之间的区域。以平面径向畴壁为例，作者发现涌现塞曼场和自旋轨道场可产生空间分离的三重态热点及节点态到全能隙超导区的转变，并指出超电流还能诱导具有交替磁对称性的四极力矩。

item.title: 氯吸附FeSe单层中的涌现d波交替磁性
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Zi-Hao Ding, Ze-Feng Gao, Kai Liu, Peng-Jie Guo, Zhong-Yi Lu
该研究基于对称性分析和第一性原理计算，提出通过单侧氯吸附和栅控空穴掺杂在单层FeSe中工程化实现稳健交替磁性。计算表明，空穴掺杂稳定棋盘格磁序，而非对称配体环境破缺面外空间反演对称性，两者协同产生最高约620 meV的巨大交替磁自旋劈裂。该交替磁态及其巨大自旋劈裂在模拟体相极限的十层薄片模型中仍保持稳定，为在FeSe基超导平台中引入交替磁性提供了可行路径。

item.title: 交替磁性单层 Cr₂S₂ 中自旋-谷锁定与谷霍尔效应的分数量子铁电控制
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Tao Yao, Quan Shen, Jiansheng Dong, Jianing Tan
本文基于第一性原理计算提出单层 Cr₂S₂ 可作为二维分数量子铁电—交替磁性耦合平台。两个可切换的分数量子铁电态由包含分数晶格平移与时间反演或宇称-时间反演的复合对称操作联系。铁电切换可在不旋转 Néel 矢量的情况下反转交替磁性自旋极化能带并交换 X/Y 谷的自旋特征，同时反转 Berry 曲率分布，从而实现极化控制的自旋-谷锁定和谷霍尔效应。

item.title: 层间滑移方向作为交替磁性双层 Fe₂WS₄ 中的对称性选择器：可切换反常霍尔效应与反常谷霍尔效应
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Quan Shen, Jianing Tan, Tao Yao, Wenhu Liao, Jiansheng Dong
本文基于第一性原理计算研究交替磁性双层 Fe₂WS₄ 中层间滑移方向对对称性、铁电性及输运响应的选择性控制。对角滑移破缺反演对称性，产生具有相反面外极化的滑移铁电态，并可通过极化反转切换动量依赖自旋织构和反常霍尔电导。相比之下，轴向滑移保持反演对称性但破坏关联 X/Y 谷的晶体对称性，从而导致可逆谷极化和可切换反常谷霍尔效应。

item.title: 以微波驱动和合成反铁磁体作为耗散器实现驱动-耗散氮空位中心的长程稳态纠缠
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Federico Garcia-Gaitan, Branislav K. Nikolic
该文研究金刚石中两个相距较远的氮空位中心在驱动-耗散条件下形成稳态纠缠的机制。作者从微观上推导了以微波辐射为驱动、以处于平衡态的单一磁性浴为耗散环境的 Lindblad 量子主方程，并给出实现长程稳态纠缠的条件。结果表明，合成反铁磁体是优选的耗散环境；在实验可实现参数下，两个相距约 100 nm 的氮空位中心稳态 concurrence 可达约 0.28。

item.title: 双层Ruddlesden-Popper镍酸盐中的磁有序
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Yiming Wang, Guijing Duan, Zhiguang Liao, Kuan-Sen Lin, Rong Yu, Qimiao Si
针对双层镍酸盐La3Ni2O7中高温超导邻近密度波序的现象，作者提出以有效局域磁矩及其RKKY和超交换相互作用来描述其磁关联。该框架给出接近Q=(π/2,π/2)的磁有序波矢，并能清晰解释相关自旋动力学。研究结果与近期关于双层镍酸盐密度波序中磁关联的实验进展相符，并讨论了其对非常规超导的启示。

item.title: 磁性 Weyl 半金属中的单极自旋密度波态
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Xi Luo
该研究提出 Weyl 半金属中由同手性 Weyl 节点所包围嵌套费米面之间粒子—空穴配对产生的单极自旋密度波态。作者表明，其序参量继承非平庸配对 Berry 相位，可由单极谐函数描述，并在能隙函数中产生受拓扑保护的节点结构。基于具体晶格模型，论文讨论了螺旋型和摆线型自旋密度波在能带、费米弧分布及表面自旋极化中的可观测差异。

item.title: 双层 ReIrGe₂Se₆ 中的多态铁电性与可切换层锁定反常谷霍尔效应
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Tao Yao, Quan Shen, Jianing Tan, Jiansheng Dong
本文通过第一性原理计算预言 AA0 堆垛双层 ReIrGe₂Se₆ 中存在多态铁电性。体系具有四种能量稳定的铁电极化构型，其中三种可通过可逆路径相互切换，另一种呈现单向切换路径，并伴随半导体—金属—半导体的循环电子结构演化。研究还指出铁电极化切换与层自由度及 Berry 曲率紧密耦合，可用于调控层锁定的反常谷霍尔响应。

item.title: 二维交替磁体中的脊—自旋—层耦合与新兴脊电子学
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Mu Tian, Run-Wu Zhang, Chaoxi Cui, Zhi-Ming Yu, Yugui Yao
本文提出二维交替磁体中的脊—自旋—层耦合概念，其中动量空间中一维连续的无色散电子态线与自旋极化和原子子层锁定。该机制类似平带物理中的动能淬灭，但同时允许外场控制，例如选择性切换倒空间脊方向、实现自旋过滤输运以及产生特殊电霍尔响应。基于共线自旋层群对称性，作者识别出 Mg₂Mo₂(PO₅)₂、Ca(FeP)₂ 和 Mg₂V₂(SO₅)₂ 三种候选二维材料，并提出“脊电子学”作为可控方向选择性电流的平台。

item.title: 自旋 1 三角反铁磁体 NiI₂ 中显著的配体介导键依赖相互作用
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Hao Xu, Weiqin Zhu, Shufan Cheng, Yanyan Shangguan, Song Bao, Junbo Liao, Bo Zhang, Zihang Song, Shuai Dong, Maofeng Wu, Stanislav E. Nikitin, Travis J. Williams, Changsong Xu, Jinsheng Wen
该工作研究范德瓦尔斯磁体 NiI₂ 的磁激发，结合非弹性中子散射、磁化测量、磁结构分析、第一性原理计算和线性自旋波模拟，建立了包含显著 Kitaev 相互作用和非对角 Γ 相互作用的最小模型。结果表明，这些各向异性相互作用共同稳定倾斜磁基态并在自旋波谱中打开能隙。尽管 Ni²⁺ 磁离子的轨道矩被淬灭，强相互作用仍可由配体离子的自旋—轨道耦合驱动，为弱自旋—轨道磁离子体系中实现强键依赖各向异性提供了实验证据。

item.title: 由自旋群对称性揭示共线铁磁体中的自旋霍尔效应
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Qing Zhang, Yizhuo Song, Jiahao Shentu, Jianting Dong, Jia Zhang
该研究将自旋轨道耦合视为破缺自旋群对称性的微扰，以阐明共线铁磁体中时间反演偶与时间反演奇自旋霍尔电流的微观来源。一阶自旋轨道耦合下，作者识别出与磁化无关的常规贡献和与反常霍尔电荷输运相关的磁化依赖通道，同时指出主要的时间反演奇磁性自旋霍尔效应来自常规自旋流与局域磁化之间的交换作用。二阶自旋轨道耦合还产生一种不同的时间反演奇平面自旋霍尔机制，第一性原理计算支持其强各向异性特征。

item.title: 合金化范德华反铁磁体中可调磁-激子耦合
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Maciej Smiertka, Oliwia Janikowska, Katarzyna Olkowska-Pucko, Grzegorz Krasucki, Katarzyna Posmyk, Paulina Peksa, Alessandro Surrente, Dimitar Pashov, Kseniia Mosina, Zdenek Sofer, Mark van Schilfgaarde, Adam Babinski, Maciej R. Molas, Gabriela Komorowska, Esteban Zamora-Amo, Andres Castellanos-Gomez, Federico Mompean, Mar Garcia-Hernandez, Michal Baranowski, Swagata Acharya, Paulina Plochocka
本文研究氯掺入如何调控范德华反铁磁体 CrSBr₁₋ₓClₓ 中磁有序与激子的耦合。通过最高 85 T 的磁光光谱和基于合金超胞的准粒子自洽 GW 计算，作者表明 Cl 引入会逐步局域化激子波函数，使局域 Frenkel 型 XA 激子和较离域 Wannier-Mott 型 XB 激子均趋向更 Frenkel 化。该演化伴随磁场诱导能量重整化的系统性减弱，显示合金化可作为调节层状磁性半导体中磁-激子相互作用的有效手段。

item.title: Coexistence of high temperature superconductivity and antiferromagnetic order in a cuprate with multiple hole Fermi pockets
item.description:
📚 Nature Communications
👤 Xiangyu Luo, Yinghao Li, Hao Chen, Yiwen Chen, Jumin Shi, Taimin Miao 等26位作者
Nature Communications, Published online: 17 July 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-75301-4 The authors study cuprate superconductor Bi2Sr2Ca6Cu7O18+δ with seven CuO2 planes in the unit cell, finding multiple hole-like Fermi pockets in the (π/2,π/2) nodal region. They observe strong electron pairing with an energy gap as high as ~ 42 meV on one of the highly-underdoped inner planes where a robust antiferromagnetic order persists.

item.title: A short review on the maximum clique problem algorithms with classical, AI, and quantum methods
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Raffaele Marino, Lorenzo Buffoni, Bogdan Zavalnij
arXiv:2403.09742v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: This manuscript provides a comprehensive review of the Maximum Clique Problem, a computational problem that involves finding subsets of vertices in a graph that are all pairwise adjacent to each other. As such, this review is a continuation of the series of previous reviews from 1994, 1999 and 2014. The manuscript covers in a simple way classical algorithms and includes a review of recent developments in graph neural networks and quantum algorithms.

item.title: 在路径积分蒙特卡罗中学习费米子符号结构
item.description:
📚 arXiv

arXiv:2607.14640v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Battery health estimation is fundamental for battery management in battery-powered systems, where inaccurate health states may affect control, maintenance, and service life. It becomes even more critical in intelligent connected systems, where estimation errors can propagate across interconnected devices and downstream decisions. In this paper, we propose TIDE, a trustworthy and interpretable battery degradation estimator for reliable battery health estimation. TIDE jointly considers accuracy, trustworthiness, and interpretability, which are all essential for practical deployment and downstream decision making.
